test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Infant mortality is the death of an infant before his or her _______birthday.
solution:
The correct answer is **__first__.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Infant mortality is the death of an infant before his or her first birthday.**
 
• The infant mortality rate is the** number of infant deaths for every 1,000 live births.**
 
• **India's infant mortality rate (IMR) has shown significant improvement, falling from 47 in 2010 to just 28 in 2020.**
 
• The decline in the infant mortality rate is seen over the past few decades.
 
• **One in every 36 infants still dies within the first year** of their life in India, according to official data.
 
• **The Infant Mortality Rate (IMR**), is widely accepted as a** crude indicator of the overall health scenario of a country or a region.**
 
• The corresponding decadal **decline in IMR in rural areas is 48 to 31, **and **for urban areas, it is from 29 to 19.**
 
• In 2020,** the maximum IMR** has been reported for** Madhya Pradesh (43) and the minimum for Mizoram (3).**
